claims.quote: if you're charging five bucks, you get 100 folks on it, you do the math.

acquisition_channels.details: The host recommends finding target coaches in the same forums or groups where complaints appear and asking questions before pitching; no customer acquisition results are reported.

ideas.delivery: The app sends a message to parents and collects confirmations for the coach. Before building, the host suggests manually texting parents and sending the coach a confirmation list.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies to handling parents' contact and confirmation data. PECR governs promotional SMS, and DMCC Act subscription requirements may be relevant to recurring billing.
